Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant pyuria, bacteriuria, hematuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Mild glucosuria is present without ketonuria. Low urine specific gravity may indicate impaired concentrating ability. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of urinary tract infection management.
